final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT CustomerId AS c, SUM(Total) AS t FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(t) AS tot FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.c AS c, s1.t AS t, s1.t / NULLIF(s2.tot, 0) AS r FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.tot IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS a FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.c AS c, s3.t AS t, s3.r AS r, (s3.r - s4.a) / s4.a AS d FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.r > s4.a) SELECT AVG(t), AVG(r), AVG(d) FROM s5
